title: Babylon
lead: The city on the Euphrates runs through the whole Bible: Babel's tower (Genesis 11:9), the empire that destroyed Jerusalem and carried Judah into exile (2 Kings 25), the target of the prophets' oracles (Isaiah 13–14; Jeremiah 50–51), and in Revelation "Babylon the Great," the city that rules the kings of the earth (Revelation 17:18).
